text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(My stomach... Did I throw myself too hard 
into kata practice...? 
Perhaps I should eat so—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—Nay! Clear your mind and banish all 
thought!! 
........................ 
...Nothingness. ........................)

And so—Phalaenopsis threw herself into 
her Zen meditation so stoically that she 
missed her chance to eat altogether.
